tbesh_html:
1) to penetrate, cut, attack, invade
1a) (Qal) to penetrate, cut into
1b)(Hithpoel)
1b1) to cut oneself
1b2) to gather in troops or crowds
Aramaic equivalent: ge.dad (גְּדַד "to chop" H1414)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to crowd; also to gash (as if by pressing into)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: assemble (selves by troops), gather (selves together, self in troops), cut selves.
